hero.summary: I make games, build little worlds, and turn curious ideas into playful experiences. From 3D and mobile to VR & AR, there’s always something new brewing at my desk.
hero.note: A few games. A lot of curiosity.

about.title: Little about me
paragraphs: With 8 years of robust experience in creating 3D, VR/AR, and mobile games, I have honed my skills as both a team player and an independent developer. I have a strong foundation in programming and a passion for creating immersive and engaging experiences for players. My portfolio showcases a variety of projects that demonstrate my versatility and ability to work on different platforms and with different technologies.

In addition to my experience in game development, I have strong communication and teamwork skills, which have allowed me to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and contribute to the success of projects. I am always looking for new challenges and opportunities to learn and grow as a developer.
about.imageAlt: Jignesh wearing sunglasses and a white shirt, seated outside a café.
